name: Testing — Six opens Tlog
request: Replace link Six foreground with the existing Tlog photo library; update indexed Testing and Pages.

implementation.label: Six
implementation.media: Tlog video pauses on leaving; captured late-play events are paused while hidden. Music audio continues independently.
implementation.frame: One lazy same-origin frame, fixed dimensions when hidden; inert and unavailable to input while inactive.
implementation.home: Tlog Home returns to Testing's original default state without loading nested Testing.
implementation.history: Embedded viewer uses local Back and does not modify host history; standalone hash mode retained.
implementation.archive: Six no longer selects its former archive background/video; One–Five and Music retain archive media.
